top_signals.title: The Debasement Trade Splits as Gold and Bitcoin Bets Diverge
top_signals.summary: With Treasuries sinking and the dollar falling this year, Bitcoin and gold are again being touted as hedges against currency debasement.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Potential AI slowdown is not ‘end of the world’ for data center real estate, says Digital Realty CEO
top_signals.summary: Digital Realty and Equinix, two of the largest data center REITs, saw their stocks slump after warnings over AI advancements.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Traders Game Plan What 10-Year Yield at 5% Spells for US Stocks
top_signals.summary: Markets already had plenty to worry about as a historically volatile period for stocks kicks into high gear. A jump in the 10-year Treasury yield above 5% for the first time in almost three years upped the pressure even further.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Brightshore Capital Launches $250 Million Property Debt Platform
top_signals.summary: Global real estate firm Brightshore Capital, formerly known as GTIS Partners, has launched its first real estate debt investment platform with an initial capital of $250 million at a time when homebuilders’ financing needs are mounting.
